checksum_scheme: Git blob SHA-1 from Git Trees API; not a separately computed SHA-256 checksum. git_blob_sha is null for MANIFEST.json to avoid a self-referential checksum.
last_updated_note: Git Trees API does not supply per-path last-commit timestamps. last_updated is null rather than guessed; retrieve each path's commit history if exact dates are required.
